item.title: Core Keeper Fishing Guide — Best Spots, Bait, the Fishing Workbench and Rare Fish
item.description: Fishing in Core Keeper is more than a side activity: it is a second ore income, a key source of accessories, and the only way to summon Omoroth later. This advanced Core Keeper fishing guide explains how the catch system decides what you pull out, how to set up a fishing corner, and which water to stand in for the rare fish and valuables you actually want. item.title: Core Keeper Gear Progression Guide — Copper to Solarite Armor and Weapon Tiers
item.description: Gear in Core Keeper follows the same ring-biome ore ladder as mining: copper → tin/bronze → iron → scarlet → octarine → galaxite → solarite. This gear progression guide maps each tier to its armor set, the weapon worth crafting, and the accessory slots that actually move your build — so you stop wasting bars on upgrades you’ll wear for ten minutes. Armor sets by tier Every armor piece breaks down the same way: a helm, a chest and pants, each with its own durability.

item.title: Core Keeper Mining Guide — Wall Hardness, Drill Efficiency and the Best Digging Routes
item.description: The ore tier guide tells you which ore lives in which ring. This guide goes deeper: how mining damage actually resolves against walls, how to plan tunnels so you never waste swings, and how drills turn ore boulders into an infinite late-game ore supply. How wall damage really works A wall does not have a simple health bar. Every hit first deducts a flat resistance, and only the leftover damage bites into wall health.

item.title: Core Keeper Ore Tier Guide — Pickaxe Progression and Where Each Ore Spawns
item.description: Core Keeper’s world is generated in rings around the Core, and each ring holds different ores. This Core Keeper ore guide maps every ore to the pickaxe tier and biome you need — so you never waste time mining with the wrong tool.
